steps.name: a_home_fields
steps.desc: home zoom: the hamlet's two hedged crop fields (near end, west side) and its orchard (north-west), the market's garden at its near end; fields placed where an author would, at the street ends and beside the last houses

steps.name: a2_home_market
steps.desc: home zoom, framed on the market town: its garden at the near end of the street

steps.name: b_close_crops
steps.desc: close: the two hedged crop fields at the hamlet's near end and west side

steps.name: c_close_orchard
steps.desc: close: the orchard, trees in a loose grid over mown green alleys with blossom round each trunk

steps.name: c2_close_garden
steps.desc: close: the market town's garden at its near end, broad beds each one mass of colour

steps.name: d_ghost_crops
steps.desc: the pointer just past the hamlet's west houses: the refused crop disc drawn in salmon over the house, pill 'Over a building: lay it on open ground'

steps.name: d2_ghost_open
steps.desc: the ghost of a crop field on open ground between the villages' near ends: the brush ring's ink and chalk stroke over the ochre disc

steps.name: f_720_pane
steps.desc: 1280x720: a picked crop field; Lay out above a compact Character row, the room line, the size row and Remove

steps.name: h_720_pane_market
steps.desc: 1280x720: the market town picked, laying its default Garden; Crops greyed with the reason on its own line under the tiles

steps.title: fields look
steps.intro: Villages phase 3 first slice, round 4 on an 80 m (320 ft) map: hedged crop fields, an orchard with alleys and blossom, a garden of broad beds, the ring strokes and the 720 pane. The round 4 A/B captures a0..a3 (plain, hedgerow, calm margin, both) stay beside these from the probe run.
